instruction: Look at gui05_bracket_dimension_seed.dxf. Do not move the existing outline or holes. Add complete dimension annotation: overall length 160 mm, overall height 90 mm, left hole distance 30 mm from the left edge, right hole distance 30 mm from the right edge, and two diameter 12 mm hole notes. Put every dimension entity or equivalent dimension text on layer DIM and set dimension text height to 3.5 mm. Save as /home/user/Desktop/gui05_bracket_dimension_completed.dxf. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
